message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts. The case: Defendant bought/obtained 150 kg of bulk salt, knew it might be non-compliant, used it to process tea eggs sold to others. Salt lacked iodine, violating standards. In iodine-deficient area, must use iodized salt. He used non-iodized salt, which is a food safety violation. Likely crime: "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品" or "生产、销售不合格食品" (illegal production/sale of unqualified food). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品" (Article 144 of Criminal Law). Also possibly "非法添加、未添加碘的食盐" but the main is "生产、销售不合格食品". The examples show similar: "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" for selling harmful food. Here it's non-iodized salt used in food, causing health risk. So charge: "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品". Could also be "非法生产、销售食盐" but likely the generic.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品<eoa>
